text:
rachel: quick note 1: we saw inconsistent behavior during a cross-mode rollout. hosted honored `fallback=true`, dedicated ignored it (kept pinned), private returned 502 on mismatch.

tom: that's the same class of issue we've seen, but different surface. where is the semantic gap?

mike: controlplane emits `preferred-variant` + `fallback` flag. adapters map to local policy. no enforced contract today.

priya: we should define a tiny v1 contract. idea: a single header `X-Redwood-Policy: v1;fallback=allow|deny;pin=error|warn` plus a probe endpoint so controlplane can detect adapter semantics.

rachel: agree. also need a migration default so older adapters don't break: default `fallback=allow;pin=warn`.

tom: how to handle private/on-prem where sidecars lag? probe should be async and non-blocking for rollouts. mark tenant capability `unknown/warn/ok` in manifest.

mike: ops: add alert `policy-compat` when canary errors spike with mismatched semantics. runbook: check `/.well-known/redwood` -> if absent mark legacy -> rollback canary.

infra-bot: alert: policy-compat tenant=foo %err=6.2 window=3m

priya: UI: show compatibility badge on rollout page and refuse full rollout if policy requires `pin=error` and adapter reports `warn`.
rachel: add audit log entry with policy_version and adapter_capabilities so we can trace regressions.

tom: corner case: proxies that strip `X-*` headers. mitigation: add short-lived signed header `X-Redwood-Sig` and document header-preservation for on-prem.
mike: timeline: implement probe + header in controlplane next week, adapters roll patches over 4 weeks. we'll keep defaults conservative.

priya: i'll draft the RFC and include probe schema example and UI mock. anyone wants to co-author?
rachel: i'll add the runbook details. tom: i'll own alert rules.

mike: cool. let's keep probe simple: `GET /.well-known/redwood-adapter` -> JSON blob with `fallback_support` and `pin_mode` (non-blocking). controlplane marks tenant and shows status.

infra-bot: info: canary started for policy-v1 -> 5% traffic

priya: closing loop: RFC PR when ready, keep rollout guarded by compat badge.
